title: A lisse continuous module has a lattice on a qcqs etale cover
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite dimensional normed Q_ell algebra which is a normed field, and X a scheme with noetherian underlying topological space. Use the continuous integral and rational coefficients and their map of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Suppose P is an internal module over the rational coefficient ring on X, locally finite free on a pro-etale cover in the module sense of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. There are a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme U, an etale surjection p:U→X, and an internal integral module M on U which is pro-etale locally finite free, together with an isomorphism from its ordinary scalar extension to the canonical coefficient pullback p^*P. Ranks may vary and may be zero; the empty scheme is allowed. No descent or stratification is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the affine etale lattice-neighborhood theorem independently at each point x of X. Its proof uses the explicit coefficient encoding, the remaining encoding-compatibility interface and the existing sectionwise etale lattice existence theorem.

Etale maps are open by Mathlib Scheme.Hom.isOpenMap. The images of these point neighborhoods form an open cover; noetherianity implies compactness, so isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover gives a finite subfamily. Form its scheme coproduct. Etaleness is Zariski local at the source, and surjectivity follows from the finite cover. A finite coproduct of affine schemes is affine, so it is compact and quasi-separated. The empty base is included.

Apply continuousLattice_finite_coproduct to the selected integral lattices and their rationalization isomorphisms. It supplies the lattice and exact raw pro-etale local-freeness predicate on the coproduct. Return this coproduct, its etale surjection and the constructed lattice.

proof_origin.note: B2 stage-3: explicit encoding constructions and proof of the full finite-cover/assembly argument; only local-freeness and lattice compatibility of those encodings remains as a new named theorem. Existing theorem and all target signatures unchanged. C4 quarantine restoration (2026-10-21): restore the complete archived module at its original path and preserve its public theorem, imports and proof dependencies. The finite affine etale subcover argument and coefficient-wise finite coproduct assembly compile against the current restored dependency interfaces, with zero local proof holes.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousLisse_etale_lattice
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hP : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj P)) :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (p : U ⟶ X), Etale p ∧ Surjective p ∧
      CompactSpace U ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace U ∧
      ∃ M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) U),
      (∃ D : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage U, ∀ s : D.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).obj
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) U))
          (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).mapMod _).obj M)) ∧
      Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) U)).obj M ≅
        (CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj P)
